description: Extracts document content for LLM understanding with the native engines (pdf/pptx/docx/xlsx) and protocolToMarkdown. Keeps tables, headings and line breaks; docx pictures become image markers. Pass ocr=true for PDFs whose figures are pasted images.

steps_hint: Copy the source into a unique active/shared/tmp/<job>/ dir (inputs must be inside the repo)
Read it: `pnpm kyberion read <file> [--ocr]` from a shell, or media:document_digest (ocr=true) in a pipeline — never a hand-written parser
Analyze and summarize the Markdown; act on `> [read]` warnings and re-check OCR figures against the source
use_cases: ドキュメント要約・理解
hints._comment: Pattern A: fully automatable. No browser interaction needed; media-actuator handles document extraction directly.
